people.name: Aramitess
people.line: Concubine of Manasseh; mother of Asriel

people.name: Asriel
people.line: Son of Gilead, descendant of Manasseh

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
translations.bsb: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel through his Aramean concubine. She also gave birth to Machir the father of Gilead.
